title: Total Spread of Every Window
statement:
A sensor reports `n` temperature readings in order. For any block of exactly `k` consecutive readings, its spread is the largest reading in the block minus the smallest one. Add up the spreads of all `n - k + 1` blocks of length `k`.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `k`. The second line contains `n` integers, the readings in order.

## Output
Print the sum of the spreads of all blocks of `k` consecutive readings. The answer can be larger than 32 bits.

## Constraints
- `1 <= k <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
